fieldData.full-article-text:
On the initial Olympia mainnet release, development will be limited and focused on the creation of fixed-supply tokens via API.

We expect that true developer interest comes at the following Alexandria release. Here we will provide the first versions of Scrypto and Radix Engine v2, running in a private off-ledger environment so that developers can begin experimenting with creating DeFi and other functionality in a new and powerful way.

This “preview release” of Scrypto will then lead into the Babylon release of the Radix network where on-ledger deployment of Scrypto-based smart contracts (called “components”) will become possible. This will come with the launch of an on-ledger catalog of reusable “blueprints” that make common functionality highly accessible and reusable, a decentralized developer royalty system, and more.

More information about Scrypto and Radix Engine v2 will be released closer to the release of Alexandria.
